source_evidence.title: Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Document Question Answering
source_evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/209_Knowledge Graph Prompting for Multi-Document Question Answering.pdf
source_evidence.text:
Abstract
The ‘pre-train, prompt, predict’ paradigm of large language
models (LLMs) has achieved remarkable success in open-
domain question answering (OD-QA). However, few works
explore this paradigm in multi-document question answer-
ing (MD-QA), a task demanding a thorough understanding
of the logical associations among the contents and structures
of documents. To fill this crucial gap, we propose a Knowl-
edge Graph Prompting (KGP) method to formulate the right
context in prompting LLMs for MD-QA, which consists of
a graph construction module and a graph traversal module.
For graph construction, we create a knowledge graph (KG)
over multiple documents with nodes symbolizing passages or
document structures (e.g., pages/tables), and edges denoting
the semantic/lexical similarity between passages or document
structural relations. For graph traversal, we design an LLM-
based graph traversal agent that navigates across nodes and
gathers supporting passages assisting LLMs in MD-QA. The
constructed graph serves as the global ruler that regulates the
transitional space among passages and reduces retrieval la-
tency. Concurrently, the graph traversal agent acts as a local
navigator that gathers pertinent context to progressively ap-
proach the question and guarantee retrieval quality. Extensive
experiments underscore the efficacy of KGP for MD-QA, sig-
nifying the potential of leveraging graphs in enhancing the
prompt design and retrieval augmented generation for LLMs.
Our code: https://github.com/YuWVandy/KG-LLM-MDQA.
1

relation_review.evidence: 核对全部必要事实、引用与原文；没有来源时不得补造。
relation_review.semantics: 核对关系方向、实体角色、任务/实验条件和题干前提。
relation_review.uncertainty: 必要证据不足时明确说明缺口；反例允许纠正前提。

scoring_rules.semantic: Codex review of task retention and ownership; not independent human scoring
scoring_rules.primary: 逐题保留目标与归属质量审阅；不把JSON成功当质量成功
scoring_rules.latency: wall time includes model load; separately report load/prompt/eval durations

evaluation_config.planned_output: 题面子查询拆分；不运行检索或答案生成

controls.prompt:
任务是从题面提取子查询素材，绝不回答问题，也不使用论文知识。
只读取 question 和 allowed_methods。按 allowed_methods 顺序，每个方法输出一个单元。
所有 local_aspect、shared_task、unresolved 字符串必须逐字复制题面的连续片段，不改写，不增字，不自行补标点。方法名由程序添加。
local_aspect：只属于该方法的技术描述或任务对象。shared_task：适用于所有方法的共同问题、目的、比较维度和限制。
两个字段不可有重复或重叠的片段。方法专属描述不准放入 shared_task；shared_task 不准包含任何方法名或前者/后者/它们/两者等悬空指代。
若题面写明前者/后者，只按题面两个方法的出现顺序解析，标 assignment=pronoun；原文片段从前者或后者开始，程序负责去除代词。
若技术描述紧接自己的方法名，标 explicit。找不到明确属于某方法的描述，local_aspect 留空，标 shared_only，保留有信息的共享任务。
仅仅列出两个方法、然后列出两种技术，不能凭论文知识或列举顺序猜测对应关系。归属不明的技术片段放 unresolved，不强行分配，也不把它们都当 shared_task。
reason 最多12个汉字，只解释题面依据。不要重复方法名或说明论文答案。
示例题面：甲法与乙法怎样处理输入？前者处理表格，后者处理段落。
甲法的 local_aspect=["前者处理表格"]，乙法的 local_aspect=["后者处理段落"]，两者 shared_task=["怎样处理输入？"]，assignment=pronoun。
示例题面：甲法与乙法怎么编码？比较甲编码和乙编码。
不能猜测编码归属：local_aspect=[]，shared_task=["怎么编码？"]，assignment=shared_only，unresolved=["甲编码和乙编码"]。
必须保留有用的问句目标，不要仅给方法名。只输出 schema JSON。
controls.query_assembly: verified source snippets; resolved pronoun prefix may be removed
